description:
Creates an issue type screen scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

requestBody.description: An issue type screen scheme bean.

201.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["One or more issue type IDs are repeated, an issue type ID can only be specified once."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Only Jira administrators can access issue type screen schemes."],"errors":{}}

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["One or more issue type IDs were not found."],"errors":{}}

404.description: Returned if the issue type or screen scheme is not found.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Sub-tasks are disabled in Jira. At least one of the issue types is a sub-task."],"errors":{}}

409.description: Returned if the issue type is a sub-task, but sub-tasks are disabled in Jira settings.
